items.question: How much does a new garage door cost?
items.answer: Most single-car doors we install run $1,200–$2,500 installed, and double-car doors $1,800–$4,500 depending on material, insulation and windows. Custom and full-view glass doors cost more. Every project starts with a free written estimate — the price we quote is the price you pay.

items.question: My garage door spring broke. Can I still open the door?
items.answer: Please don't try. With a broken spring the opener or your arms are lifting the door's full weight — often 150–300 lbs — which can burn out the opener or cause serious injury. Leave the door closed and call us; spring replacement is usually a same-day fix.

items.question: Do you offer same-day or emergency service?
items.answer: Yes. Our phone is answered 24/7, and for stuck-open doors, trapped vehicles and broken springs we dispatch a technician as fast as possible — typically the same day within our service area.

items.question: How long does a garage door installation take?
items.answer: A standard single-door replacement takes 3–5 hours including removal of the old door. Double doors or jobs with new framing may take a full day. We confirm the timeline in your estimate and clean up completely before we leave.

items.question: Should I repair or replace my garage door opener?
items.answer: As a rule of thumb: openers under 10 years old are usually worth repairing; over 15 years, replacement often makes more sense because modern units are quieter, safer and include battery backup and smartphone control. We'll give you an honest recommendation either way.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes — fully licensed and insured, and every installation carries our 10-year workmanship warranty on top of the manufacturer's warranty on the door itself.
